_comment: MB Metallic Bellows manufacturing formulas and allowances. Every allowance that is not a fixed, universally-applicable geometric fact (e.g. a flat-pattern circumference formula) carries an approval_status - the calculation engine refuses to silently treat an 'unapproved' or 'pending' allowance as final; it is applied, labeled, and the result is flagged REVIEW_REQUIRED. Nothing here is invented: every value is transcribed from the manufacturing notes/indent sheet supplied for WO 9374 and must be re-verified before being trusted for a different work order.

blank_length.source: manufacturing team formula, confirmed against WO 9374 (OD 559 -> 1765mm, matches indent)

sheet_width.source: manufacturing team formula; q (convolution pitch) and w (convolution depth) are not reliably extractable from the CAD profile and must never be reverse-engineered to force a match to the indent's 340mm reference

convolution_count_interpretation.note: CAD drawing shows '5+5' convolutions; provisionally interpreted as N=10 total. Subject to confirmation of MB's own counting convention.

circumference_length.source: manufacturing team formula (base circumference only, no allowance)

length_allowance.source: WO 9374's indent (2190mm) exceeds the base circumference (683*3.14=2144.62mm) by ~45.38mm; this gap has not been confirmed as an approved manufacturing allowance by MB and must never be silently assumed. allowance_mm stays null (not 45.38) until approved - set it explicitly once confirmed.

id_from_od_thickness.source: standard pipe wall geometry, no manufacturing allowance
standard pipe wall geometry, no manufacturing allowance

sleeve.note: Blank calculation diameter (509mm on WO 9374's indent) is NOT automatically the same reference as the CAD OD (539mm) - the engine must keep od, id/blank_diameter, thickness and length as distinct fields rather than assuming one stands in for another.

housing_flange.note: Dimensions (OD, ID, Thickness, PCD, hole diameter, hole count) come directly from the housing flange CAD detail / indent - no calculation formula. A mismatch between the drawing's own printed hole count/PCD and the indent's must be flagged, never silently corrected in either direction.

length_allowance.source: manufacturing notes mention an additional 15mm for an unspecified operation; applicability not yet confirmed. Must never be applied to any component other than Limit Rod.

collar.note: Dimensions come from Detail B's own annotations, never derived from the overall assembly view.

length_allowance.source: packaging allowance applies to length only; breadth and width come from the approved packaging layout/clearances, never from the same 250mm formula.
